title: Station Manager 2 - Configurable Automated Netradio
abstract: Using Liquidsoap's tools to create flexible, scheduled, multi-show, playlist-driven netradio stations that are customized entirely through json configuration files.

title: Do you know what's actually on air? End-to-end testing for Liquidsoap radio pipelines
abstract: This talk presents a practical approach to end-to-end testing for Liquidsoap-based radio pipelines, focusing on how to verify what listeners actually hear rather than relying only on metadata or event-level assertions. It will cover the motivation, method, and lessons learned from testing real stream output.

title: Mikulski_24/7: original music video playlist + live
abstract: My simple but effective setup, created with no programming experience (well, almost).

title: HLS streaming with Liquidsoap
abstract: How we implemented rtmp streaming with liquidsoap and kept backwards compatibility with icecast clients.

title: Radio autómata (automaton radio) a future science and community radio station
abstract: For almost three years, with a few isolated transmissions during pandemia, "radio autómata" is an internet radio station initially created to support online courses. The attempts weren't succesufull, but we are trying new ideas to become a community radio around science and education. We'll present how it's working at the moment and the future plans.

title: KPISS new location + remote training
abstract: We will be explaining our new space and our mission for the community both in the know and new people.
